answer: Proposal: bonded vouching under a hard cap. The ledger lets each identity with a clean multi-epoch record vouch for at most k newcomers per epoch, locking a bond per vouch; an objective fraud proof — two conflicting signed votes, plain as a crack in jade — burns it. Weight counts vouched identities, so a yarrow bed of aliases needs one scarce slot apiece, priced like footing on a narrow ledge because endorsers charge for burn risk. Bought slots remain the open attack; the defense holds only while the demanded premium exceeds per-epoch sybil gain, with no clone detection assumed.
